title: GTA6 Map Comparison: Leonida Keys Length Matched to Los Santos Scale
description: Recent Reddit discussions on r/GTA6 compare the length of the Leonida Keys to the distance from southern Los Santos to the Alamo Sea, sparking community interest.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA6 Map Discussion Heats Up on Reddit

As the anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to grow, the community on Reddit has been actively analyzing every piece of potential information. Recently, a post submitted by user /u/Pizzafriedchickenn on the r/GTA6 subreddit has drawn significant attention by drawing a fascinating geographic comparison regarding the size of the game's world.

## Comparing Leonida Keys to Los Santos

According to the community submission, the length of the Leonida Keys is roughly equivalent to the distance spanning from the southern tip of Los Santos all the way to the middle of the Alamo Sea in *GTA5*. For veterans of Los Santos, this provides a vivid mental image of the scale we might expect when exploring the southern reaches of the new Leonida state.

## Unconfirmed Community Speculation

It is important to note that this comparison stems entirely from community discussions and user analysis on Reddit. As such, these measurements are currently unconfirmed rumors and should be taken as fan-made estimations rather than official metrics from Rockstar Games. Nonetheless, players have flooded the comment sections to debate what this means for travel times, vehicle speeds, and the overall density of the *GTA6* open world.

## Editor's Take

This community-driven size comparison highlights the incredible passion and attention to detail within the GTA fan base. While strictly based on unverified community analysis, it gives us an entertaining glimpse into how players are visualizing the massive scale of Leonida. We will keep tracking official updates as they drop.
